title: Apply resource protection in operations: decision comparison 1
teachingQuestion: How is data/media protected, moved, retained, and exited across provider boundaries?
focalInsight: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.
caption: Compare meaning, decision conditions, and failures. These concise distinctions are paired with the worked examples in the teaching unit.
altSummary: Definitions, decision owner/criterion, failure consequence, and retrieval remain distinct.
